trello.name: Configure Stripe subscription tiers
trello.desc: Set up Basic ($29/mo), Pro ($49/mo), and Enterprise ($99/mo) subscription tiers in the Stripe dashboard with correct pricing and feature definitions.

trello.name: Implement frontend checkout form
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe Elements for the checkout process, ensuring it matches the app's design, handles errors gracefully (invalid cards, insufficient funds), and includes a prominent checkout button, clear feature comparison for each tier, and a tooltip explaining plan changes. Update the pricing page to reflect new tiers.

trello.name: Build user dashboard functionality
trello.desc: Develop the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info, allow users to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, provide access to invoices and payment history, enable updating payment methods, reflect real-time subscription status, and notify users of plan upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Implement backend Stripe API integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe API on the backend to handle subscription creation upon payment completion, process successful and failed payments, and manage webhooks for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed (including sending email notifications), and customer.subscription.deleted (updating access rights).

trello.name: Create and execute test plan
trello.desc: Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up to billing to management). Include specific test scenarios for edge cases such as payment failures, cancellations, and webhook event handlers. Execute tests to ensure all functionality works as expected.

trello.name: Document user support and technical details
trello.desc: Create user-facing documentation, including a help section or FAQ covering common subscription issues, how to manage subscriptions, and how to access invoices. Document internal API endpoints and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting.
